heroes.name: Rook
heroes.description: A borderland survivor. Close the distance, cleave packs, and turn wounds into endurance.

heroes.name: Mira
heroes.description: The last lantern scholar. Burn from afar, freeze pursuers, and blink through danger.

heroes.name: Silas
heroes.description: Keeper of the unburied. Raise a skeletal escort and curse the debt owed by the living.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: Strike every enemy in reach. Strength increases damage.

skills.name: Leap strike
skills.description: Vault to a visible landing and strike around it.

skills.name: War cry
skills.description: Shock nearby enemies and slow their movement.

skills.name: Fire bolt
skills.description: A fast burning missile. Energy increases spell damage.

skills.name: Frost nova
skills.description: Freeze a ring of pursuing enemies.

skills.name: Teleport
skills.description: Blink to a visible, clear landing.

skills.name: Bone spear
skills.description: Pierce a line of enemies with a spectral spear.

skills.name: Raise skeleton
skills.description: Consume a slain enemy body to raise an ally. Ranks raise the army limit.

skills.name: Withering curse
skills.description: Weaken resistance in an area and inflict poison.

acts.name: Briarfen
acts.subtitle: I · The stolen lantern
acts.introduction: For a century, four lanterns kept the buried king asleep. Last night the fen lantern went dark. Warden Elian sends you to recover its ember before the other lights fail.
acts.conclusion: Inside the Widow you find a lantern chain bearing the desert regent’s seal. The theft was planned. Follow the salt road.
acts.objective: Light both ward stones; defeat the Briar Widow.

acts.name: Saltreach
acts.subtitle: II · A kingdom of glass
acts.introduction: The salt road ends at a city turned to glass. Its regent traded the second ember for immortality. Two sun obelisks still hold the palace gate shut.
acts.conclusion: The Regent shatters. His bargain names the Bellkeeper beneath the monastery, where the lanterns were first forged.
acts.objective: Kindle the sun obelisks; break the Glass Regent.

acts.name: Hollow Bells
acts.subtitle: III · The debt of the dead
acts.introduction: The monastery rings with voices of the unburied. The Bellkeeper fed the third ember to the dead. Silence his two funeral bells and take the stair below his altar.
acts.conclusion: The bells fall silent. The first wardens did not destroy the king: they imprisoned their own founder. His last ember burns under the world.
acts.objective: Silence both funeral bells; lay the Bellkeeper to rest.

acts.name: The First Furnace
acts.subtitle: IV · A light of our own
acts.introduction: Lucent built the lanterns to steal the world’s dawn. His wardens rebelled, but their prison is breaking. Return the embers to the two furnace anchors and end his claim to the light.
acts.conclusion: Lucent falls. You break the lantern chain instead of wearing his crown. Dawn reaches Briarfen, Saltreach, and the quiet monastery. Elian opens the refuge gates. The light belongs to everyone.
acts.objective: Restore both furnace anchors; defeat Lucent.

regions.name: Lantern Approach
regions.description: Rain threads between black trees. Lantern trails cross flooded hollows.

regions.name: Drowned Grove
regions.description: Drowned roots surround the first ward; the grove loops back to the lantern road.

regions.name: Root Cellars
regions.description: Old stone cellars descend beneath the marsh. Root bridges divide the burial rooms.

regions.name: Buried Sanctuary
regions.description: Water seeps into a buried sanctuary. The second ward protects the last stair.

regions.name: Heart of the Briar
regions.description: The Briar Widow has rooted herself around the stolen lantern.

regions.name: Caravan Reach
regions.description: Dunes bury the caravan road. Rock ridges shelter broken campfires.

regions.name: Shattered Oasis
regions.description: A shattered oasis holds glass monuments and the first ward.

regions.name: Sand Cistern
regions.description: Dry stairwells reach cistern chambers beneath the dunes.

regions.name: Glass Galleries
regions.description: Sand pours through vaulted glass galleries. Light the ward before descending.

regions.name: Regent’s Vault
regions.description: The Glass Regent hoards the lantern in a sunless glass vault.

regions.name: Silent Courtyard
regions.description: Cold courtyards wind among ruined chapels and stone pillars.

regions.name: Graveyard of Echoes
regions.description: Gravestones mark a circuit of paths around the first ward.

regions.name: Sepulcher Steps
regions.description: Sepulcher stairs pass sealed burial rooms and bone caches.

regions.name: Bell Foundry
regions.description: A buried foundry forged the bells that held the dead asleep.

regions.name: Unburied Choir
regions.description: The Bellkeeper conducts the unburied around the stolen lantern.

regions.name: Ashen March
regions.description: Ash paths wind between ruined watchtowers and cooling slag.

regions.name: Cinder Crossing
regions.description: Bridges cross cinder channels toward the first ward.

regions.name: Slagworks
regions.description: The slagworks descend through stone chambers scorched by molten seams.

regions.name: Chain Galleries
regions.description: Chains hang above the second ward and the sealed crucible stair.

regions.name: Lucent’s Crucible
regions.description: Lucent waits below the furnace, where all four lantern roads converge.
